title: The most venomous animals
text: There are many dangerous animals in the world. Some are big and strong, like the lion. Others are small, but they have venom. A very strong venom can kill a person.

The box jellyfish is a jellyfish. It lives in the sea, near Australia. It is almost transparent, so it is difficult to see. It has very long tentacles with venom. It is the most venomous animal in the sea!
The taipan is a snake from Australia. It lives in the desert. Its venom is the strongest of all snakes. But the taipan is shy: it usually does not attack people.
The golden poison frog is very small and yellow. It lives in the jungle in Colombia. Its skin has poison. Its bright color says to other animals: Be careful! Do not eat me!
The blue-ringed octopus is small and pretty, but be careful! When it is afraid, its blue rings shine. It is a signal: Do not touch me.

grammar.rule: The verb to be has three forms in the present: am, is and are.
